author: Chao-Jen Huang (ephoton)
title: Spectre Simulation Configuration
description: Simulator-specific configuration for the spectre driver (analysis/measurements/driver_config) -- deliberately NOT part of schema/ujob.schema.json's workflow item, which only defines orchestration (driver/rundir/arguments/files/results). This is staged into the workflow step's rundir as its own tar member (filename: simulation_config.json, see ujob_builder.SIMULATION_CONFIG_FILENAME) exactly like any other input file declared in workflow[].files[] -- the ujob workflow never carries simulator-specific keys directly. See development/simNexus/VIRTUOSO_SPECTRE_UJOB_TAR_ANALYSIS.md for the responsibility-boundary rationale.

$schema.description: The schema of this simulation configuration.

analysis.description: Spectre analysis statements to inject into the netlist (see spectre_batch.py:_build_injections). Each entry's extra fields (start/stop/dec/dev/step/...) are analysis-type-specific -- see development/simDriverSpectre/02_CLI_MAPPING.md.

name.description: Analysis statement name (defaults to '{type}Ana' if omitted).

measurements.description: Named signal expressions to extract from PSF output after simulation (spectre_batch.py:collect/_filter_measurements). Restricts the returned measurements dict to exactly these names when non-empty.

name.description: Measurement name, used as the key in the returned measurements dict.

expr.description: PSF signal name/expression to read (e.g. a node voltage like 'vout').

aps_mode.description: Accelerated Parallel Simulation mode flag (e.g. 'aps', 'apsdc'); null disables it.

save_signals.description: Signal names for an injected `save` statement.
